caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mechanical device consisting of a rectangular block of wood as the main body, colored in various shades of light and medium brown. Attached to the right side of the block are several narrow vertical wooden rods or pegs mounted in a row, held in place between two flat, horizontal wooden slats. On top of the horizontal slats is a circular knob or handle. A single long wooden stick or peg protrudes downward from the bottom slat, making it appear as if the device could be held or fixed through this part. The wood grain, edges, and some surface wear are visible on the block, and several small round-headed fasteners are present on the visible face of the main block. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, with the drawing rendered in realistic, natural tones. The artist’s signature "Ralph Jde Poviltais" appears in small, red text below and to the right of the object.
title: Ecclesiastical Rattle
